column1: # B I — NIST ASD, captured 2026-08-14, register 1639.
# destination_url VERIFIED — spectrum=B+I confirmed. Levels in cm-1.
# CAPTURE ONLY. Nothing extracted per R 1638.
# ** SEVEN LIMITS — more than any species in the queue: **
# ** THE FIRST n=2 CORE IN THE QUEUE. Every other species has a 3s/3p/3d
#    or 4s core; B I's is 2s2. So the one-electron-outside structure is
#      n=3:  K VII, Ca VIII, Sc IX, Ti X  3s2.nl
#      n=4:  Ge II, As III, Se IV, Br V   4s2.nl
#    THAT IS BOARD ROW 17's COMPARISON AT THREE SHELLS.
# The 2s2.nd series runs n = 3..39 — the second-deepest in the queue
# after Ge I. s to 10, p to 9, d to 39, f to 11.
# ** A J-NOTATION NOT SEEN BEFORE: unresolved pairs written "1/2,3/2"
#    and "3/2,5/2" — the two fine-structure components measured
#    together and not separated. NOT the same as a missing J. Kept
#    verbatim; the reading pass must not read "1/2,3/2" as a value. **
# +x rows carry an unknown additive constant and cannot yield a defect.
# The 1s-hole block at ~1.5 million cm-1 is a K-SHELL vacancy series and
# converges on the last two limits; kept separate.
